context: Revalidate the actual Dask constructor timing, MCP admission limits, and deployment resource budget in w0. Define one policy function that checks worker count, threads per worker, total threads, per-worker memory, and aggregate memory; make limits configurable only by server-owned policy, not request fields. Decide how use_distributed=false interacts with worker settings and reject contradictory combinations rather than silently ignoring them. Apply the same validator to run_benchmark, start_benchmark, and the worker execution path. Add bounded tests at ordinary, boundary, and over-envelope values, and document that per-field maxima are not the security control. Do not add scheduler_address, spill_directory, endpoint, or path controls to MCP.
description: Close the PR #1465 resource-exhaustion defect in the Dask platform_options surface. Independent maxima of n_workers=256 and threads_per_worker=256 allow one authenticated MCP request to construct a 65,536-thread LocalCluster; a per-worker memory_limit of 1TB can advertise a 256TB aggregate envelope. Dask's conservative defaults apply only when the caller omits the values, and use_distributed defaults true, so the unsafe request reaches LocalCluster during adapter construction. Define an explicit server-side aggregate CPU, worker-count, and memory envelope for MCP, with fail-closed validation before synchronous adapter creation and before durable persistence.

anti_patterns.dont: Apply the envelope only in the synchronous tool
anti_patterns.instead: Validate at request admission, persistence, and worker execution, with one shared policy function.
anti_patterns.why: Durable workers replay persisted requests and can bypass a front-door-only guard after retries or restarts.

anti_patterns.dont: Rely on independent n_workers and threads_per_worker maxima
anti_patterns.instead: Enforce aggregate CPU, worker, and memory budgets with explicit cross-field tests.
anti_patterns.why: Their product is the actual CPU/thread pressure and is unbounded enough to exhaust a host.

anti_patterns.dont: Start a real 65,536-thread cluster to prove rejection
anti_patterns.instead: Assert rejection before adapter construction and use a spy to prove LocalCluster is never called.
anti_patterns.why: The test itself would be a denial-of-service vector.

preserves.behavior: CLI and non-MCP Dask users retain their existing configuration surface and defaults.
MCP requests cannot select an external Dask scheduler, spill directory, filesystem path, or arbitrary endpoint.
Rejected requests fail before LocalCluster creation and before durable-job persistence, with no leaked resource values or secrets.
The existing server-wide and principal concurrency limits remain enforced; the new envelope is an additional per-run guard, not a replacement.

work_units.evidence: Constructor timing: DaskDataFrameAdapter.__init__ calls _setup_distributed() -> LocalCluster(**cluster_kwargs) during construction (dask_df.py:198,323), so any guard after adapter construction would have to start the oversized cluster to detect it. Admission limits: AdmissionLimits/JobLimits (security.py:61,74) bound requests_per_minute, global/principal concurrency, queue depth and leases -- none bounds a single run's cluster size, so the envelope is additive. Approved budget: adapter local caps are _DEFAULT_LOCAL_WORKER_CAP=2, _DEFAULT_LOCAL_THREADS_PER_WORKER_CAP=2, _DEFAULT_LOCAL_MEMORY_LIMIT=2GB; server-owned aggregate defaults selected as 16 workers / 64 total threads / 64GB total, operator-overridable via BENCHBOX_MCP_DASK_MAX_*. w0 probe confirmed n_workers=256 x threads_per_worker=256 = 65536 threads admitted before the fix.
work_units.summary: Revalidate Dask constructor timing, MCP admission limits, and the approved host resource budget

work_units.evidence: Added DaskResourceEnvelope + load_dask_resource_envelope() (env-overridable, bounded, falls back on malformed/out-of-range) and _validate_dask_options() enforcing max_workers, n_workers x threads_per_worker, and n_workers x memory_limit. Unset fields use the adapter's own local caps (2/2/2GB) so an omitted field can never contribute more than the adapter applies.
work_units.summary: Implement one server-owned aggregate CPU, worker, and memory envelope with contradictory-combination rejection
